name: Ordering Width
definition: For an ordering $\pi=(c_1,\ldots,c_m)$ of a nonempty finite binary class $C$, take at step $j$ the inclusion-minimal disagreement sets $\operatorname{diff}(c_j,c_i)$ with earlier concepts, assign the step the largest such cardinality minus one (and zero at the first step), and let $w(\pi)$ be the maximum step cost. Then $\sigma(C)=\min_\pi w(\pi)$.
normalization: The first step has cost zero; constant coordinates are ignored by the value.
comments: The value is invariant under coordinate permutations, bit complements, and adding constant coordinates. Its zero set is the dismantlable ample classes, a class not yet promoted in the database.
